nodes.text: Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV), first identified in 2001, is causing a stir with recent outbreaks. Symptoms? Think common cold but can escalate to pneumonia, especially in kids & seniors. No vaccine yet, so keep up hygiene, avoid sick folks, & mask up if needed. #HMPV #HealthUpdate
